name: Project Closed Last Month
query:
SELECT
    ps.work_team AS "Work Team:Link/Work Team:200",
    wt.team_name AS "Team Name::200",
    COUNT(ps.name) AS "Projects Closed Last Month:Int:150"
FROM
    `tabProject Setup` ps
LEFT JOIN
    `tabWork Team` wt ON wt.name = ps.work_team
WHERE
    ps.status = 'Completed'
    AND ps.completion_date >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE() - INTERVAL 1 MONTH, '%%Y-%%m-01')
    AND ps.completion_date < DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%%Y-%%m-01')
GROUP BY
    ps.work_team, wt.team_name
ORDER BY
    COUNT(ps.name) DESC;
